title: CurrentFailureRecord
description:
The one minimal CURRENT failure/blocking representation status derivation reads without consulting history (CTR-03, DEC-07, Contract 5.6).

This is not an event log. At most one record exists per job at a time. A successful current replacement clears or supersedes it, and the superseded copy may move to audit history. Status must never replay archived events, and a planted marker file has no status authority.

operation.description: Affected stage or deterministic operation, e.g. STAGE2, STAGE3, RENDER, VALIDATE.

classification.description: FAILED: a current attempt/artifact is mechanically invalid and recovery remains available. BLOCKED_MANUAL: the configured or simple recovery path is unavailable or exhausted; independent jobs continue regardless (Spec 15.3).

applies_to_hashes.description: The artifact/input hashes this failure applies to, so a later valid replacement is distinguishable from the failed state.

violations.description: All detected mechanical violations or render diagnostics from one pass (Contract 8.1).

attempts_used.description: Bounded and visible. No hidden retries and no orchestration engine (DEC-36, ACC-14).

retry_position.description: Index into the frozen retry_start_stages array, when that convenience is in use.

recorded_at.description: For audit display only. It carries no status authority.
